# `FluxRegistrar::register_save_chunk`

<span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge-ABI">ABI</span> <span class="sdk-kind">method</span>

Source: **ABI v4** (`src/plugins/abi.rs`). Generated group: **Methods**.

## Description

Registers one save-chunk descriptor owned by this plugin.

## Signature

```rust
fn register_save_chunk (& mut self , descriptor : & FluxSaveChunkDescriptor ,) -> Result < () , FluxStatus >
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `descriptor` | & [`FluxSaveChunkDescriptor`](../structures/fluxsavechunkdescriptor.md) | `descriptor` argument passed as `& FluxSaveChunkDescriptor`. |

## Return Value

Result < () , [`FluxStatus`](../structures/fluxstatus.md) >

## SDK Example

_Source: [`examples/methods/fluxregistrar-register-save-chunk.md`](../../examples/methods/fluxregistrar-register-save-chunk.md)_

```rust
fn register_chunk(registrar: &mut FluxRegistrar) -> FluxStatus {
    let descriptor = FluxSaveChunkDescriptor {
        id: FluxUtf8Slice::from_str("flux.demo.save.counter"),
        version: 1,
    };
    match registrar.register_save_chunk(&descriptor) {
        Ok(()) => FluxStatus::OK,
        Err(status) => status,
    }
}
```
